create_GenomeQAClassificationDataset: create a GenomeQAClassificationDataset instance with dataroot, tokenizer, and image features reader for visual question answering
build_dataset_entries: build dataset entries by loading Visual Genome data from cache and tokenizing questions with BERT tokenizer
run_tokenize: run tokenize on dataset entries to convert questions into BERT token sequences with padding and segment IDs
run_tensorize: run tensorize to convert tokenized entries and answer labels into PyTorch tensors
get_dataset_item: get a dataset item by index returning image features, spatial boxes, question tokens, and answer targets
